[[File:Ice warrior icon.png|left]]
An '''Ice warrior''' is a monster similar in appearance to a [[knight]] in blue, somewhat translucent armour. They reside near ice or in frozen caves and are most easily fought in the [[Asgarnian Ice Dungeon]]. Ice warriors are not aggressive to players with a combat level of 109 and above.

Mid-level [[food]] (such as [[lobsters]], [[swordfish]], or [[beltfish]]) is recommended for players between the [[combat level]]s of 70 and 90, as any type of food above that will likely be a waste of money. Higher-levelled players will likely need little to no food.

Ice warriors appear to be wielding [[longsword]]s, but their [[attack speed]] is 4.

==Training spots==
{{Needs image|Images of safespotting strategy should be provided to provide better clarity, as well as more concise safespotting information}}
There are ice warriors mixed with three [[ice giant]]s in the [[Asgarnian Ice Dungeon|dungeon]] just south of [[Port Sarim]]. There is also a room full of ice warriors guarding the [[Ice Queen]] under [[White Wolf Mountain]] (level 50 [[mining]] is required to enter), however it is a long walk through tunnels of [[ice spider]]s and ice giants. It may be a good idea to bring a [[Summoning familiars|summoning familiar]] or a [[dwarf multicannon]].

Ice warriors can be safe spotted on White Wolf Mountain by standing next to the rock slide. (There are several spots that work. The safest option is 2 squares south and 1 square east of the first stalagmite you see as you enter the room from the west.)

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Magic ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Melee ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Ranged ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=patch|update=November PostJam Patch Week - This Week In RuneScape|date=25 November 2024}}
** Replaced the [[tiny blunt mithril salvage]] drop with [[willow wood spirit]]s.
** Replaced the [[maple logs]] drop with [[teak wood spirit]]s.
** Replaced the [[tiny plated iron salvage]] drop with [[tiny blunt mithril salvage]].

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Housing of Parliament & Double XP- This Week In RuneScape|date=12 February 2024}}
** Rebalanced several low level monsters that were harder to kill than intended

*{{UL|type=update|update=Wilderness Reborn & New Quest - This Week In RuneScape|date=1 August 2022}}
** Removed the ice warriors, [[ice giant]]s and [[ice spider]]s from the [[Frozen Waste Plateau]], replacing them with [[glacor]]s, [[wyvern]]s and [[acheron mammoth]]s respectively.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (16 January 2017)|date=16 January 2017}}
** Ice warriors that were inconsistently weak to air, water or earth are now weak to fire.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (9 November 2009)|date=9 November 2009}}
** Fixed a long standing issue where ice warriors would lose the transparency of their models in combat.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Runescape updated (24 May 2001)|date=24 May 2001}}
** Added to game.
** The [[Asgarnian Ice Dungeon]] has been expanded and improved.
*** It now also includes the new ice warrior monsters.
}}

==Trivia==
* Ice warriors still use the walk, stand and death animations of old RuneScape.
* Ice warriors appear to have the old model of armour.
* While the ones in the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon have a male voice when they are hit and die, the ones near the Ice Queen have a female voice. It is unknown if this was intentional or not.
* Two ice warriors in the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon and the ones near the Ice Queen display used to be weak to water spells. This was changed in the [[Update:Patch Notes (16 January 2017)|patch notes]] on [[16 January]] [[2017]].
